{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Skull Chopping}}''' - Throws its axe at a random tower or unit in its range of 15, applying a 4 second 25% [[Range Debuff]] to any tower hit or dealing 1,000 damage to any unit hit. |ability1_cooldown = 8 }} ==Description== The '''Executioner Skeleton''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had a high amount of health and [[Shield Health]], an above average speed and 50% [[Defense]], reducing most forms of damage by 33%. It has one ability where it throws its axe at a tower or unit withing its 15 range. This applies a 4 second long [[Range Debuff]], decreasing tower range by 25%, ordeals 1,000 damage to units. ==Appearance== The '''Executioner Skeleton''' is made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than most other enemies and has two large black eyeholes. It wears a brown belt, brown torn cape, grey crown and shoulder-pads, and grey knee-pads, armbands and chestplate, which have a black skull with blue glowing eyes. It wields a large black axe with a black skull which has blue eyes. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended here. **As it occasionally spawns as a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, towers with hidden detection or with it applied to them through other towers or modifiers are especially useful. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of your towers, with the [[DJ Booth]] even being able to partially mitigate its [[Range Debuff]]. *The [[Medic]] cannot be used against the '''Executioner Skeleton''', as it does not protect towers from debuffs. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:SkeletonDeath.ogg]] |When the '''Executioner Skeleton''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseExecutionerSkeleton.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (31 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ExecutionerSkeletonEnemyIconIG.png|'''Executioner Skeleton''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **'''Executioner Skeleton''' added. **{{Bug}} Has no animations in the [[Index]]. **{{Bug}} Default [[Shield Health]] of 25,000 is never applied, it only has [[Shield Health]] in modes with specific values set for them. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Executioner Skeleton''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b **{{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Now has a default [[Shield Health]] value of 25,000. {{BlindFaith|[[Null Accelerator]]|Wave 25|[[Skeleton]], Executioner Skeleton, [[Giant Skeleton]], [[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)|Hallow Guard]] & [[Null Necromancer]]|Wave 27|[[Rift Walker]]|Wave 30}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Executioner Skeleton}}
